A FEW LITTLE DETAILS

Before you
say yes.

What do I get?+

A digital .xlsx wedding planner with 28 worksheets: 27 planning and guide sheets, plus a hidden calculation sheet. It covers everything from priorities and budgeting to the wedding timeline and honeymoon budget.

Which software do I need?+

The planner is designed for Microsoft Excel and is best used on a desktop or laptop. Excel is not included. Compatibility with Google Sheets, Apple Numbers, or mobile spreadsheet apps has not been verified.

Can I customise the planner?+

Yes. Add your wedding details, budget, guests, and plans in the workbook's editable fields. The included instructions explain how to use each section and which formula cells to leave unchanged.

Is this a physical planner?+

No, this is a digital spreadsheet. Nothing is shipped. The workbook includes a Printable Summary worksheet for the details you want to take with you.

How do I purchase it?+

The planner is priced at RM30. Checkout is coming soon; the purchase button will be connected here when the shop opens. No payments are currently collected on this page.
